name: Nangate Open Cell Library, typical
purpose: Research-only standard-cell mapping and area estimation; the platform is intentionally non-manufacturable.

license.note: The license distributed with this pinned OpenROAD platform is retained with the unchanged library and its original notices.

area.basis: Liberty cell area cross-checked against LEF cell width times height in micrometres.
area.measurement: Sum of mapped instance counts times Liberty cell area; excludes placement whitespace, routing, clock distribution and physical-only cells.

FILLCELL_X2.note: Physical filler with no logic function; not an ABC mapping target. Do not interpret its Liberty area as physical footprint.
